insurance_highlights.value: Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption Insurance
insurance_highlights.quote: Protect your trip with trip cancellation and interruption insurance when you charge at least 75% of costs to your card.
Receive up to $1 million CAD in emergency medical coverage for you, your spouse, and your eligible dependent children.
If you charge at least 75% of your ticket to your card, you’re eligible for reimbursement of necessary expenses if your flight is delayed up to $500 per insured person on the same trip.
If your checked luggage is delayed or lost, you’re covered up to $500 if you charged the full cost of your travel ticket to your card.
When you charge at least 75% of your trip to your card, you’re insured against accidental loss of life or dismemberment up to $500,000 per insured person and up to $1,000,000 for the trip occurrence.
